refundPolicy.checkoutLine: No refunds. Cancel anytime — your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for.
refundPolicy.termsParagraph: Payments are non-refundable, including for partial billing periods and unused time, except where the law requires it. You can cancel at any time in Manage Plan: your plan stays active until the end of the billing period you have already paid for and is not renewed after that. When you move to a lower plan, or from annual to monthly billing, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing period; until then you keep your current plan. When you move to a higher plan, it starts right away and you pay the prorated difference for the rest of the current period.
refundPolicy.managePlanLine: No refunds. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the period you've paid for, then it isn't renewed.
